from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class LiabilityRecord(BaseModel):
    """Extracted liability information from a single financial document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company or trust in the document")
    liability_label: str | None = Field(description="The line-item label as written (e.g., 'Total Liabilities', 'Current Liabilities')")
    liability_amount: float | None = Field(description="The liability amount reported")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The date as of which the liability figure is reported")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt containing the figure and label")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    liability_records: list[LiabilityRecord]
